purpose: #672 QA inputs selected for a matched experiment prompted by the failed main CI conversion of 14 Nov 2026 (run 43645465508 attempt 1). The historical npm manifest and executable bytes were not retained; these fixed versions do not establish a byte-identical reproduction of that installation. npm values come from the public registry entries of @github/copilot and @github/copilot-win32-x64, winget values from the public winget-pkgs installer manifests of GitHub.Copilot 1.0.111 and 1.0.112. A registry mismatch on the runner stops the batch before any vendor iteration.

provenance.note: InstallerSha256 of the x64 MSI in those manifests. winget checks its download against its own source manifest; QA does not hash the MSI, and an MSI hash is not the installed copilot.exe hash. The installed copy is qualified on the runner by winget's exit, the copilot.exe SHA-256 measured there and its --no-auto-update --version answer.

arms.A: ordinary product probe: argv exactly as built (`--version`)
arms.B: same product flow; the Copilot version probe receives the program's declared childUpdateArgs (`--no-auto-update`) before `--version`
